figures.title: Design support and source-release concordance
figures.caption: Ageing comparisons require design and release checks. All 73 source records join, but 47 cell totals differ; 24-month females and lung droplet samples are absent. Tissues and brain releases overlap. Two pooled lung libraries are excluded from individual-mouse counts.

figures.title: Captured-cell composition and sampling sensitivity
figures.caption: To assess tissue remodelling, captured bladder fractions are compared by mouse. From 3 to 24 months, urothelial cells increase (44.0% to 75.9%) and mesenchymal cells decrease (50.3% to 15.7%). These are captured proportions, not absolute abundance. Points: mice; bars: means; triangles: females.

figures.title: Deposited microglial cluster-label audit and animal-level occupancy
figures.caption: Microglial heterogeneity is assessed through deposited clusters: blue, 1/6; orange, 10/12/14; grey, others. From 3 to 24 months, occupancy shifts from 58.7% to 6.9% (blue) and 0.5% to 6.8% (orange). Final-paper cluster mapping remains unresolved; UMAP establishes no trajectory. D/E: mouse points and means; triangles: females.

figures.title: Marker frequency, conditional expression and composition accounting
figures.caption: Separate RNA endpoints assess detection, expression intensity and composition. Lung Cdkn2a detection increases from 0.65% to 1.42% (3 to 24 months). RNA establishes neither senescence nor secretion. Points: mice; bars: means; triangles: females. D compares all captured cells with an equal-type reference restricted to shared types.

figures.title: T-cell clonal-family fractions and sampling sensitivity
figures.caption: To assess sampling effects on apparent clonal expansion, older mice retain higher T-cell clonality after standardizing to 60 reconstructed cells. Tissue sampling and reconstruction remain alternative explanations; clonality does not measure immune function. B–D: mouse points and means; sex is not encoded.

figures.title: Within-population marker differences and sex sensitivity
figures.caption: Fixed markers assess whether age-associated RNA changes agree across resident immune populations. Il1b detection directions differ across tissues, and the kidney direction reverses in the male-only subset. Values: 24 minus 3 months, in percentage points; n: young/old mice. Different populations, assays and reused mice preclude independent replication or a conserved-mechanism claim.
